310: 	{
311: 		queue_cnt = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
312: 		free_cnt  = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - queue_cnt;
313: 	}
314: 	else
315: 	{
316: 		free_cnt  = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
317: 		queue_cnt = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - free_cnt;
318: 	}
319: 	
320: 	if( free_cnt <= 1 )  // reserved one for empty judgement.
321: 	{
322: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
323: 		
324: 		return  IPC_ROUTE_QUEUE_FULL;
325: 	}
326: 	
327: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
328: 	
329: 	// memcpy(&ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx], ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
330: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
331: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
332: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
333: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
334: 	
335: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue);
336: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx = tx_idx;
337: 
338: 	// it is the first item pushed to the queue, then try to send.
339: 	if(queue_cnt == 0)
340: 	{
341: 		mb_chnl_write(ipc_route->log_chnl, &ipc_cmd->mb_cmd);
342: 	}
343: 
344: 	// Put mb_chnl_write inside the critical section to avoid sending the same message twice
345: 	// in multi-core operation scenarios. If another core interrupts here after the queue is updated
346: 	// but before mb_chnl_write is called, two cores might attempt to send the same message simultaneously.
347: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);  /* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
348: 
349: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
350: }

352: /* 
353:  * it MUST be protected by critical-section.
354:  * it is called by RX-ISR.
355:  */
356: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
357: static int ipc_router_fwd(mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
358: {

362: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
363: 	{
364: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
365: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
366: 	}
367: 
368: 	// forward this cmd.
369: 	return ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
370: }

373: static void ipc_router_rx_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
374: {
375: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
376: 
377: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
378: 	/* please refer to <design document> P45 rx_isr 2). */
379: 	// if it is a fwd cmd/rsp.
380: 	if( ipc_cmd->dst_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )  // it is not for me, then forward it.
381: 	{
382: 		BK_ASSERT(CURRENT_CPU == MAILBOX_CPU1); // in current configuration, CPU1 used to forward cmd.
383: 
384: 		ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_router_fwd(ipc_cmd);
385: 
386: 		return;
387: 	}
388: 	#endif
389: 
390: 	// it is for me, process the cmd/rsp.
391: 
392: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd/rsp.
393: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
394: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
395: 
396: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
397: 
398: 	#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
399: 	if(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
400: 	{
401: 		// ipc_socket may be == NULL, don't reference it.
402: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "rx error: cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
403: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
404: 	}
405: 	#endif
406: 
407: 	return;
408: }

410: static void ipc_router_tx_cmpl_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
411: {
412: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)ack_buf;
413: 	u32                route_id = (u32)param;
414: 
415: 	// data sanity check.
416: 	if(route_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl))
417: 	{
418: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, id=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, route_id);
419: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
420: 	}
421: 
422: 	// data sanity check - protect queue access with critical section
423: 	u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
424: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
425: 	{
426: 		// queue empty.
427: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
428: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, indx=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
429: 			ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx);
430: 		
431: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
432: 	}
433: 
434: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
435: 	
436: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx];
437: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
438: 
439: 	// data sanity check.
440: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
441: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
442: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
443: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
444: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
445: 		#endif
446: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
447: 	{
448: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
449: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
450: 
451: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
452: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
453: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
454: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
455: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
456: 		#endif
457: 
458: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	/* remove the first cmd from the queue. */
462: 	temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
463: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue);
464: 	ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx = tx_idx;
465: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
466: 
467: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
468: 	// it is a forwarded cmd/rsp.
469: 	if( ipc_cmd->src_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )
470: 	{
471: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
472: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
473: 		{
474: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fwd failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
475: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
476: 		}
477: 
478: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
479: 	}
480: 	#endif
481: 
482: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
483: 	
484: 	// search the ipc_socket by port;
485: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_sender(ipc_cmd->src_port, ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, ipc_cmd->dst_port);
486: 
487: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
488: 	{
489: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx error @%d!, cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
490: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
491: 
492: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
493: 	}
494: 
495: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
496: 
497: tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd:
498: 
499: 	/* refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3). */
500: 
501: 	// protect queue access with critical section to avoid race condition
502: 	temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
503: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
504: 	{
505: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
506: 		return;  // no pending cmd in the queue.
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	// use updated tx_idx (which is the current out_idx after increment)
510: 	u16 next_tx_idx = ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
511: 	queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[next_tx_idx];
512: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
513: 
514: 	// send next pending cmd. // refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3).
515: 	mb_chnl_write(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].log_chnl, &queue_cmd->mb_cmd);
516: 
517: 	return;
518: 
519: }

528: static mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket_search_sender(u8 src_port, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port)
529: {
530: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = NULL;
531: 	
532: 	if( IS_SERVER_PORT(src_port) )

534: 		int svr_idx = src_port - SERVER_PORT_MIN;
535: 		
536: 		for(int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR; i++)
537: 		{
538: 			if(ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i].dst_port != dst_port)
539: 				continue;
540: 			if(ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i].dst_cpu != dst_cpu)
541: 				continue;
542: 
543: 			ipc_socket = &ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i];

545: 			// data sanity check.

565: 		}
566: 
567: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC

711: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
712: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
713: 
714: /*
715:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
716:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
717:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
718:  * 
719:  */
720: static int ipc_socket_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
721: {
722: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
723: 	{
724: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
725: 	}
726: 	
727: 	u32               temp;
728: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
729: 
730: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
731: 	{
732: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
733: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
734: 	}
735: 
736: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
737: 	
738: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
739: 
740: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
741: 
742: 	if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
743: 	{
744: 		// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
745: 		mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS);
746: 	}
747: 
748: 	return route_status;
749: }
750: 
751: /*
752:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
753:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
754:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
755:  * 
756:  */
757: static int ipc_socket_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd, u32 retry)
758: {
759: 	if(retry == 0)
760: 	{
761: 		ipc_socket->tx_tag++;
762: 	}
763: 	ipc_cmd->tag = ipc_socket->tx_tag;
764: 	
765: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
766: 	{
767: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
768: 	}
769: 	
770: 	u32               temp;
771: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
772: 
773: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
774: 	{
775: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
776: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
777: 	}
778: 
779: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
780: 
781: 	mb_atomic_set(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
782: 	
783: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
784: 
785: 	if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
786: 	{
787: 	//	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
788: 		mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
789: 	}
790: 
791: 	return route_status;
792: }

816: static void ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t * ipc_cmd)
817: {
818: 	// if it is a rsp.
819: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 1). */
820: 	if( ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG )
821: 	{
822: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
823: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
824: 		{
825: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Rsp failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
826: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
827: 		}
828: 
829: 		// completed the rx-process, so clear the flag.
830: 		// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
831: 		mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS);
832: 
833: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnect rsp send ok.
834: 		{
835: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
836: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
837: 		}
838: 		
839: 		return;
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	// it is a cmd.
843: 
844: 	// check if TX_IN_PROCESS flag is still set, if not, tx_cmd may have been overwritten by new request
845: 	if((ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) == 0)
846: 	{
847: 		// TX_IN_PROCESS flag cleared, tx_cmd may have been overwritten by new request
848: 		// ignore this ACK as it may be for an old request
849: 		return;
850: 	}
851: 
852: 	// check tag match first to ensure this ACK is for the current request
853: 	// if tag doesn't match, tx_cmd may have been overwritten by new request
854: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
855: 	{
856: 		// tag mismatch, this ACK is for an old request, ignore it
857: 		return;
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	// queue_cmd points to the tx_cmd, ipc_cmd must match the current state of tx_cmd.
861: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_socket->tx_cmd;
862: 
863: 	// data sanity check.
864: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
865: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
866: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
867: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
868: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
869: 		#endif
870: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
871: 	{
872: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
873: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
874: 
875: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
876: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
877: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
878: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
879: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
880: 		#endif
881: 
882: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
883: 	}
884: 	
885: 	// if send failed.
886: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 2). */
887: 	if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
888: 		(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
889: 	{
890: 
891: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
892: 		{
893: 			// mailbox channel tx failed. 
894: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_FAILED;
895: 		}
896: 		else  // (ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
897: 		{
898: 			// router failed.
899: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->route_status;
900: 		}
901: 
902: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
903: 
904: 		return;
905: 	}
906: 
907: }

909: static int ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
910: {
911: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
912: 	{
913: 		// no connection for this rsp.
914: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
915: 	}
916: 
917: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) == 0 )	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
918: 	{
919: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNSOLICITED_RSP;
920: 	}
921: 
922: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
923: 	{
924: 		/* un-matched response. */
925: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
926: 	}
927: 
928: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd != (ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_CMD_MASK))
929: 	{
930: 		/* un-matched response. */
931: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
932: 	}
933: 
934: 	// data sanity check.
935: 	if( (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
936: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
937: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
938: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
939: 		#endif
940: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
941: 	{
942: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
943: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, %d != %d.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
944: 			ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag, ipc_cmd->tag);
945: 		#endif
946: 
947: 		/* not the response for the CMD just sent. */
948: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
949: 	}
950: 
951: 	#if 0   // can't clear connection here, becasue tx_cmpl_isr will use this connection again.
952: 	        // if there is direct connection between 2 cores, rsp will arrive ahead of cmd-tx_cmpl_isr.
953: 	if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnected.
954: 	{
955: 		// it must have been disconnected in the peer side.
956: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
957: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
958: 	}
959: 	#endif
960: 
961: 	/* save cmd return-status, tx is completed. */
962: 	if(ipc_cmd->api_impl_status != IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK)
963: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->api_impl_status;
964: 	else
965: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_OK;
966: 
967: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
968: 
969: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // this status return is worthless but for debug.
970: }

973: {

975: 
976: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);

122: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
123: {
124: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
125: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
126: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
127: 
128: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
129: 
130: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
131: 	{
132: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
133: 		{
134: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
135: 		}
136: 
137: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
138: 		{
139: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
140: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
141: 		}
142: 
143: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
144: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
145: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
146: 
147: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
148: 
149: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
150: 		{
151: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
152: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
153: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
154: 		}
155: 		else
156: 		{
157: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
158: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
159: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
160: 			{
161: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
162: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
163: 				#endif
164: 				__DMB();
165: 				
166: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
167: 
168: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
169: 			}
170: 			else
171: 			{
172: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
173: 			}
174: 		}
175: 
176: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
177: 
178: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
179: 
180: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
181: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
182: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
183: 
184: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
185: 
186: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
187: 	}
188: 	else
189: 	{
190: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
191: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
192: 
193: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
194: 
195: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
196: 		{
197: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
198: 		}
199: 		else
200: 		{
201: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
202: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
203: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
204: 			{
205: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
206: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
207: 				#endif
208: 				__DMB();
209: 				
210: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
211: 
212: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
217: 			}
218: 
219: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
220: 		}
221: 
222: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
223: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
224: 	}
225: 
226: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
227: 
228: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
229: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
230: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
231: 	 */
232: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
233: 
234: 	return;
235:

238: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
239: {
240: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
241: 	{
242: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
243: 			return;
244: 
245: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
246: 
247: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
248: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
249: 		{
250: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
251: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
252: 
253: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
254: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
255: 		}
256: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
257: 		{
258: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
259: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
260: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
261: 
262: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
263: 
264: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
265: 
266: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
267: 			{
268: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
269: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
270: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
271: 			}
272: 			else
273: 			{
274: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
275: 				{
276: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
277: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
278: 					#endif
279: 					__DMB();
280: 
281: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
282: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
283: 				}
284: 				else
285: 				{
286: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 			
290: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		return;
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	/*
301: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
302: 	 */
303: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
304: 
305: 	return;
306: 
307: }

313: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
314: 		return BK_OK;

337: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);

339: 		return ret_code;

341: 
342: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
343: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
344: 	{
345: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
346: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
347: 
348: 		return ret_code;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
352: 
353: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
354: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
355: 
356: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
357: 
358: 	return BK_OK;
359: }

361: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
362: {
363: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
364: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
365: 
366: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
367: 		ipc_init();
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
371: 		return BK_FAIL;
372: 
373: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
374: 
375: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
376: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
377: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
378: 
379: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
380: 
381: 	do
382: 	{
383: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
384: 		{
385: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
386: 			break;
387: 		}
388: 
389: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
390: 			cmd_len = 0;
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
393: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
394: 
395: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
396: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
397: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
398: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
399: 
400: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
401: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
402: 		{
403: 			break;
404: 		}
405: 
406: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
407: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
408: 		{
409: 			break;
410: 		}
411: 
412: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
413: 
414: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
415: 		{
416: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
417: 			break;
418: 		}
419: 
420: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
421: 		{
422: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
423: 			break;
424: 		}
425: 
426: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
427: 		{
428: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
429: 			break;
430: 		}
431: 
432: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
433: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
434: 
435: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
436: 
437: 	}while(0);
438: 
439: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
440: 
441: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
442: 
443: 	return ret_val;
444: 
445: }

495: static u32 ipc_cmd_handler(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)
496: {
497: 	/* must NOT change ack_buf->hdr. */
498: 
499: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
500: 	ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
501: 
502: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
503: 
504: 	ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff;
505: 
506: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)
507: 	{
508: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:
509: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u16))
510: 			{
511: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
512: 
513: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
514: 
515: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
516: 				{
517: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
518: 				}
519: 				else
520: 				{
521: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
522: 				}
523: 			}
524: 			else
525: 			{
526: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
527: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
528: 			}
529: 			break;
530: 
531: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
532: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
533: 			{
534: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
535: 
536: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
537: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
538: 
539: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
540: 				
541: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
542: 			}
543: 			else
544: 			{
545: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
546: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
547: 			}
548: 			break;
549: 
550: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:
551: 			{
552: 				// return PS flag to caller.
553: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
554: 
555: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
556: 
557: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);
558: 
559: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
560: 			}
561: 			break;
562: 
563: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
564: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
565: 			{
566: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
567: 				bk_usb_cdc_start();
568: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
569: 			}
570: 			break;
571: 
572: 		case IPC_CPU0_CLOSE_USB_CDC:
573: 			{
574: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
575: 				bk_usb_cdc_close();
576: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
577: 			}
578: 			break;
579: 		case IPC_CPU0_STOP_USB_CDC:
580: 			{
581: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
582: 				bk_usb_cdc_stop();
583: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
584: 			}
585: 			break;
586: 
587: 		case IPC_CPU0_INIT_USB_CDC_PARAM:
588: 			{
589: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
590: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
591: 				bk_usb_cdc_init(p_cdc_data);
592: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
593: 			}
594: 			break;
595: 
596: 		case IPC_CPU0_SET_USB_CDC_CMD:
597: 			{
598: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
599: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
600: 				bk_cdc_acm_bulkout(p_cdc_data);
601: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
602: 			}
603: 			break;
604: #endif
605: 
606: #if (USB_CDC_CP0_IPC)
607: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPLOAD_USB_CDC_DATA:
608: 			{
609: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
610: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
611: 				if (p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb) {
612: 					p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb();
613: 				}
614: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
615: 			}
616: 			break;
617: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPDATE_USB_CDC_STATE:
618: 			{
619: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
620: 				extern void (*usb_cdc_state_cb)(bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status);
621: 				bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status = (bk_cdc_hub_status *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
622: 				if (usb_cdc_state_cb) {
623: 					usb_cdc_state_cb(cdc_status);
624: 				}
625: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
626: 			}
627: 			break;
628: #endif
629: 
630: 
631: 
632: 		#ifdef AMP_RES_SERVER
633: 		case IPC_RES_ACQUIRE_CNT:
634: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_res_req_t))
635: 			{
636: 				ipc_res_req_t * res_req = (ipc_res_req_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
637: 				amp_res_req_cnt_t * res_cnt_list = (amp_res_req_cnt_t *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
638: 
639: 				/* call amp_res_acquire_cnt in interrupt disabled state. */
640: 				u32  int_mask = ipc_enter_critical();
641: 				bk_err_t ret_code = amp_res_acquire_cnt(res_req->res_id, res_req->cpu_id, res_cnt_list);
642: 				ipc_exit_critical(int_mask);
643: 
644: 				if(ret_code == BK_OK)
645: 				{
646: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(amp_res_req_cnt_t);
647: 
648: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
649: 				}
650: 				else
651: 				{
652: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
653: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
654: 				}
655: 			}
656: 			else
657: 			{
658: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
659: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
660: 			}
661: 			break;
662: 
663: 		case IPC_RES_RELEASE_CNT:
664: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_res_req_t))
665: 			{
666: 				ipc_res_req_t * res_req = (ipc_res_req_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
667: 				amp_res_req_cnt_t * res_cnt_list = (amp_res_req_cnt_t *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
668: 
669: 				/* call amp_res_release_cnt in interrupt disabled state. */
670: 				u32  int_mask = ipc_enter_critical();
671: 				bk_err_t ret_code = amp_res_release_cnt(res_req->res_id, res_req->cpu_id, res_cnt_list);
672: 				ipc_exit_critical(int_mask);
673: 
674: 				if(ret_code == BK_OK)
675: 				{
676: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(amp_res_req_cnt_t);
677: 
678: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
679: 				}
680: 				else
681: 				{
682: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
683: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
684: 				}
685: 			}
686: 			else
687: 			{
688: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
689: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
690: 			}
691: 			break;
692: 
693: #if CONFIG_GENERAL_DMA
694: 		case IPC_ALLOC_DMA_CHNL:
695: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
696: 			{
697: 				u32  user_id = *((u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
698: 
699: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u8);
700: 
701: 				u8 * chnl_id = (u8 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
702: 
703: 				extern u8 dma_chnl_alloc(u32 user_id);
704: 
705: 				*chnl_id = dma_chnl_alloc(user_id);
706: 
707: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
708: 			}
709: 			else
710: 			{
711: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
712: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
713: 			}
714: 			break;
715: 
716: 		case IPC_FREE_DMA_CHNL:
717: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_dma_free_t))
718: 			{
719: 				ipc_dma_free_t * free_req = (ipc_dma_free_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
720: 
721: 				extern bk_err_t dma_chnl_free(u32 user_id, dma_id_t chnl_id);
722: 
723: 				bk_err_t ret_val = dma_chnl_free(free_req->user_id, (dma_id_t)free_req->chnl_id);
724: 
725: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
726: 
727: 				if(ret_val == BK_OK)
728: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
729: 				else
730: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
731: 			}
732: 			else
733: 			{
734: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
735: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
736: 			}
737: 			break;
738: 
739: 		case IPC_DMA_CHNL_USER:
740: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u8))
741: 			{
742: 				u8    chnl_id = *((u8 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
743: 
744: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
745: 
746: 				u32 * user_id = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
747: 
748: 				extern u32 dma_chnl_user(dma_id_t user_id);
749: 
750: 				*user_id = dma_chnl_user((dma_id_t)chnl_id);
751: 
752: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
753: 			}
754: 			else
755: 			{
756: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
757: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
758: 			}
759: 			break;
760: #endif
761: 
762: 		#endif
763: 
764: 		default:
765: 			{
766: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
767: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
768: 			}
769: 			break;
770: 	}
771: 
772: 	return result;
773: }

89: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
90: {
91: 	u32   cur_time;
92: 
93: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
94: 
95: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
96: 	{
97: 		return 0;
98: 	}
99: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
100: 	{
101: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
102: 		return 0;
103: 	}
104: 
105: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
106: 	{
107: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
108: 	}
109: 	else
110: 	{
111: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
112: 	}
113: 
114: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
115: 	{
116: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
117: 		return 0;
118: 	}
119: 
120: 	return 1;
121: }

129: 		start_cpu1_core();
130: 		return;
131: 	}
132: 	
133: 	if(cpu_x_id == 2)
134: 	{

138: 		return;
139: 	}

154: 	}

159: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
160: {
161: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
162: 	u32    events;
163: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
164: 	
165: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
166: 
167: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
168: 	{
169: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
170: 		return;
171: 	}
172: 
173: 	while(1)
174: 	{
175: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
176: 
177: 		if(events == 0)
178: 		{
179: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
180: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
181: 		}
182: 
183: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
184: 		{
185: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
186: 			{
187: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
188: 			}
189: 		}
190: 		
191: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
192: 		{
193: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
194: 
195: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
196: 			{
197: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
198: 				
199: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
200: 				{
201: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
202: 					{
203: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
204: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
205: 					}
206: 				}
207: 				else
208: 				{
209: 					if(retry_cnt > 0)
210: 					{
211: 						BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC retry to start core%d\r\n", cpu_x_id);
212: 						// restart_cpu_x();
213: 						break;
214: 					}
215: 					else
216: 					{
217: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
218: 					}
219: 				}
220: 
221: 				retry_cnt++;
222: 			}
223: 
224: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
225: 		}
226: 		
227: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
228: 		{
229: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
230: 			{
231: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC heartbeat timeout%d\r\n", cpu_x_id);
232: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
233: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
234: 				// restart_cpu_x();
235: 			}
236: 		}
237: 
238: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
239: 		{
240: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
241: 		}
242: 		else
243: 		{
244: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
245: 		}
246: 	}
247: }

269: }

186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

299: {
300: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
301: 
302: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
303:

305: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
306: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!

308: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
309:

311: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 0;

313: 
314: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
315: 	{
316: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
317: 		{

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

447: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
448: 	{
449: 		return ret_code;

452: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
453: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);

477: 	return BK_OK;

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

555: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
556: {
557: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
558: 
559: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
560: 	{
561: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
562: 		return BK_OK;
563: 	}
564: 
565: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
566: 
567: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
568: 
569: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
570: 
571: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
572: 
573: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
574: 	{
575: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
576: 	}
577: 
578: 	return ret_val;
579: }

581: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
582: {
583: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;

585: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
586: 
587: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
588: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = NULL;
589: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = 0;
590: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
591: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
592: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = 0;
593: 
594: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
595: 
596: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
597: 
598: 	return ret_val;
599: }

601: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)

606: 	{

613:

615: 
616: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
617: 
618: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
619: 
620: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
621: 	{
622: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
623: 	}
624: 
625: 	return ret_val;

628: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
629: {
630: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
631: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
632: 	
633: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
634: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
635: 
636: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
637: 	{
638: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	wr_len = data_len;
646: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
647: 		wr_len = rem_len;
648: 
649: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
650: 	{
651: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
652: 	}
653: 	else
654: 	{
655: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
656: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
657: 
658: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
659: 		{
660: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
661: 		}
662: 		else
663: 		{
664: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
665: 
666: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
671: 
672: 	/* trigger send! */
673: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
674: 
675: 	return wr_len;
676: }

678: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
679: {
680: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
681: 
682: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
683: 		return 0;
684: 
685: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
686: 
687: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
688: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
689: 
690: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
691: 	{
692: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
693: 	}
694: 	else
695: 	{
696: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
700: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
701: 		rd_len = buf_len;
702: 
703: 	if(rd_len == 0)
704: 	{
705: 		return 0;
706: 	}
707: 
708: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
709: 	{
710: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
711: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
712: 	}
713: 	else
714: 	{
715: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
716: 
717: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
718: 		{
719: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
720: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
721: 		}
722: 		else
723: 		{
724: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
725: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
726: 			{
727: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
728: 			}
729: 
730: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
731: 		}
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
735: 
736: 	/* rts assert...... */
737: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
738: 	{
739: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
740: 		{
741: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
742: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
743: 		}
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	return rd_len;
747: 
748: }

327: static void pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
328: {
329: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
330: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
331: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
332: 	{
333: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
334: 		{
335: boot_cp1:
336: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
337: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
338: 			#endif
339:             bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
340: 
341: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
342: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
343: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
344: 			reset_forward_log_status();
345: 			#endif
346: 
347:             start_cpu1_core();
348: 
349: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
350: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
351: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
352: 			{
353: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
354: 				{
355: 					break;
356: 				}
357: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
358: 			}
359: 
360: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
361: 			{
362: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"cp0 boot cp1[%d] time out, boot cp1 fail!!!\r\n",s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count);
363: 
364: 				/*Reset psram*/
365: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
366: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
367: 
368: 				s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count++;
369: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count < PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
370: 				{
371: 					goto boot_cp1;
372: 				}
373: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count == PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
374: 				{
375: 					#if CONFIG_WDT_EN
376: 					bk_wdt_force_reboot();//try 3 times, if fail ,reboot.
377: 					#endif
378: 				}
379: 			}
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: }

429: {

431: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
432: 
433: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d 0x%x [%d][0x%x]E_1\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state,s_pm_cp1_closing,&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
434: 	if (NULL == s_sync_cp1_open_sema)
435: 	{
436: 		rtos_init_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, 1);
437: 	}
438: 	if(s_pm_cp1_closing)
439: 	{
440: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
441: 		s_pm_cp1_sema_count++;
442: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
443: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 get sema[%d][0x%x]\r\n",s_pm_cp1_sema_count,&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
444: 
445: 		/*add protect:init again when the s_sync_cp1_open_sema free*/
446: 		if (NULL == s_sync_cp1_open_sema)
447: 		{
448: 			rtos_init_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, 1);
449: 		}
450: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, PM_OPEN_CP1_TIMEOUT);
451: 
452: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
453: 		s_pm_cp1_sema_count--;
454: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
455: 		if(ret == kTimeoutErr)
456: 		{
457: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1[%d]0x%llx %d %d %d\r\n",ret,s_pm_cp1_module_recovery_state,bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get(),bk_pm_cp1_recovery_all_state_get(),s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state);
458: 			if(bk_pm_cp1_recovery_all_state_get())
459: 			{
460: 				bk_pm_module_check_cp1_shutdown();
461: 			}
462: 		}
463: 	}
464: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d 0x%x [%d]E_2\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state,ret);
465:     if(power_state == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)//power on
466:     {
467: 		//bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1,PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
468: 		//bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
469: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
470: 		s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state |= 0x1 << (module);
471: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
472: 		pm_module_bootup_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
473:     }
474:     else //power down
475:     {
476: 		if(s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state&(0x1 << (module)))
477: 		{
478: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
479: 			s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state &= ~(0x1 << (module));
480: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
481: 			if(0x0 == s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state)
482: 			{
483: 				s_pm_cp1_closing = 1;
484: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d close 0x%llx %d\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_module_recovery_state,s_pm_cp1_boot_ready);
485: 				pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,0,0,0);
486: 				//pm_module_shutdown_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
487: 			}
488: 		}
489:     }
490: 
491:     return BK_OK;
492: }

23: #define MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL		(MAILBOX_BOX0)
24: #define MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL		(MAILBOX_BOX1)
25: 
26: #define CHNL_STATE_BUSY		1
27: #define CHNL_STATE_IDLE		0
28: 
29: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
30:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
31:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
32:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
33:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
34: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
35: 
36: typedef struct
37: {
38: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
39: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
40: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
41: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
42: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
43: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
44: 
45: 	u32		param1;
46: 	u32		param2;
47: 	u32		param3;
48: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
49: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
50: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
51: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
52: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
53: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;
54: 
55: 
56: #define CHNL_CTRL_MASK			0xF
57: /*
58:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
59:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
60:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
61:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
62:  */
63: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX		0x01
64: 
65: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX		0x02
66: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET			0x04
67: 
68: typedef union
69: {
70: 	struct
71: 	{
72: 		u32		cmd            : 8;
73: 		u32		state          : 4;
74: 		u32		ctrl           : 4;
75: 		u32		tx_seq         : 8;
76: 		u32		logical_chnl   : 8;
77: 	} ;
78: 	u32		data;
79: } phy_chnnl_hdr_t;
80: 
81: typedef struct
82: {
83: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
84: 
85: 	u32		param1;
86: 	u32		param2;
87: 	u32		param3;
88: } mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t;

94: 	u32		data1;

96: 	u32		data3;
97: } mb_phy_chnl_ack_t;
98: 
99: typedef union
100: {
101: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t		phy_ch_hdr;

200: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
201: {
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
203: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
204: 	u16 			chnl_type;
205: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
206: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
207: 
208: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
209: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
210: 
211: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
212: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
213: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
214: 		return 4;
215: #endif
216: 
217: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
218: 		return 5;
219: 
220: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
221: 		return 3;
222: 
223: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
224: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
225: 
226: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
227: 		return 1;
228: 
229: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
231: 
232: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
233: 
234: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
235: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
236: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
237: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
238: 
239: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
240: 
241: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
242: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
243: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
244: 
245: 	__DMB();
246: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
247: 
248: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
249: 
250: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
251: 
252: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
253: 	{
254: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
255: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
256: 
257: 		return 2;
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
261: 
262: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
263: 
264: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
265: 	{
266: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	return 0;
270: }

272: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)

274: 	u8		log_chnl;
275: 	u8		ret_code;

285: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
286: 
287: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
288: 
289: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
290: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
291: 		return;
292: 	}
293: 
294: 
295: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
296: 	{
297: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: 
302: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
303: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
304: 		return;
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
308: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
309: 
310: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
311: 	{
312: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
313: 		return;
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
317: 	{
318: 		if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
319: 		{
320: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
321: 			return;
322: 		}
323: 
324: 		log_chnl -= log_chnl_idx;
325: 
326: 		ack_ptr->hdr.data = 0;
327: 		ack_ptr->hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
328: 		ack_ptr->hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
329: 
330: 		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
331: 
332: 		if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
333: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x20;
334: 			return;
335: 		}
336: 
337: 
338: 		extern bk_err_t bk_mailbox_ready(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, uint32_t box_id);
339: 		if( bk_mailbox_ready(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx, MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL) != BK_OK)
340: 		{
341: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x40;
342: 			return;
343: 		}
344: 
345: 		// log_chnl = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl;
346: 		log_chnl += log_chnl_idx;  // don't change SRC-DST cpu-id, use only the chnl-id of tx_log_chnl.
347: 		if(log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl)
348: 		{
349: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x80;
350: 			return;
351: 		}
352: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"====mailbox reset!!%x, %x\r\n", log_chnl, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
353: 		
354: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
355: 
356: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
357: 
358: 		ack_ptr->data1 = phy_chnl_ptr->param1;
359: 		ack_ptr->data2 = phy_chnl_ptr->param2;
360: 		ack_ptr->data3 = phy_chnl_ptr->param3;
361: 	}
362: 	else
363: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
364: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
365: 	{
366: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
368: 
369: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
370: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
371: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
372: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
373: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
374: 		{
375: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
376: 			u8  i;
377: 
378: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
379: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
380: 
381: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
382: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
383: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
384: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
385: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
386: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
387: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
388: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
389: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
390: 					}
391: 					break;
392: 				}
393: 			}
394: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
395: 		}
396: 		return;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
400: 	{
401: 		/* clear following header members. */
402: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
403: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
404: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
405: 
406: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
407: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
408: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
409: 	} else {
410: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
414: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
415: 	{
416: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
417: 			break;
418: 	}
419: 
420: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
421: 	{
422: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
423: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
424: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
425: 		return;
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
429: 
430: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
431: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
432: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
433: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
434: 
435: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
436: 
437: 	if(ret_code != 0)
438: 	{
439: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
441: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
444: 
445: 	return;
446: 
447: }

1463: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1464: 
1465: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1466: 	{
1467: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1468: 	}
1469: 
1470: 	// data sanity check.
1471: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1472: 	{
1473: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1474: 	}
1475: 
1476: 	if(ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED)
1477: 	{
1478: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_STATE;
1479: 	}
1480: 
1481: 	// set the dst cpu-port firstly, because the tx_cmd/rx_rsp need these informations.
1482: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1483: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1484: 	
1485: 	ipc_socket->run_state = 0;

1487: 	ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1488: 
1489: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1490: 
1491: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD;
1492: 
1493: 	u32   retry = 0;
1494: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1495: 
1496: 	do
1497: 	{
1498: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1499: 		
1500: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1501: 		
1502: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1503: 		{
1504: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1505: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1506: 		}
1507: 
1508: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1509: 		
1510: 		if(route_status != 0)
1511: 		{

1513: 			mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1514: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1515: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1516: 			continue;
1517: 		}
1518: 		
1519: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1520: 		{
1521: 			ipc_socket->use_flag |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1522: 			return 0;
1523: 		}
1524: 		else
1525: 		{
1526: 			ret_val = -ipc_socket->tx_status;
1527: 			break;  // not retry.
1528: 		}
1529: 
1530: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1531:

1533: 	{
1534: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1535: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
1536: 	}
1537: 
1538: 	return ret_val;

1541: int mb_ipc_disconnect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1542: {
1543: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1544: 
1545: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1546: 	{
1547: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1548: 	}
1549: 
1550: 	// data sanity check.
1551: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1552: 	{
1553: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1554: 	}
1555: 
1556: 	if(dst_port == 0)
1557: 	{
1558: 		ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1559: 		return 0;
1560: 	}
1561: 
1562: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1563: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1564: 	
1565: 	// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent previous cmd from being handled in ISR.
1566: 	mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1567: 
1568: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1569: 
1570: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD;
1571: 
1572: 	u32   retry = 0;
1573: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1574: 
1575: 	do
1576: 	{
1577: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1578: 		
1579: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1580: 		
1581: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1582: 		{
1583: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1584: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1585: 		}
1586: 
1587: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1588: 		
1589: 		if(route_status != 0)
1590: 		{
1591: 			// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1592: 			mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1593: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1594: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1595: 			continue;
1596: 		}
1597: 
1598: 		if(ipc_socket->dst_port == 0)
1599: 		{
1600: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1601: 			return 0;
1602: 		}
1603: 
1604: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1605: 		{
1606: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1607: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;
1608: 			
1609: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1610: 			return 0;
1611: 		}
1612: 		else
1613: 		{
1614: 			if( (ipc_socket->tx_status > MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED) || 
1615: 				(ipc_socket->tx_status == (MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE)) )
1616: 			{
1617: 				ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1618: 				ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;
1619: 
1620: 				ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1621: 				return 0;
1622: 			}
1623: 			return -ipc_socket->tx_status;  // not retry.
1624: 		}
1625: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1626: 
1627: 	return ret_val;
1628: }

1630: int mb_ipc_close(u32 handle, u32 time_out)
1631: {
1632: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1633: 
1634: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1635: 	{
1636: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1637: 	}
1638: 
1639: 	int result = mb_ipc_disconnect(handle, ipc_socket->dst_cpu, ipc_socket->dst_port, time_out);
1640: 
1641: 	if(result != 0)
1642: 	{
1643: 		return result;
1644: 	}
1645: 
1646: 	if(IS_SERVER_PORT(ipc_socket->src_port))
1647: 	{
1648: 		// all server sockets share the same resources.
1649: 		// server sockets are not closed, so can't free any resources.
1650: 		return 0;

1653: 	// free resources.

1658: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&ipc_socket->rx_notify_sema);
1659: 	}
1660: 	
1661: 	ipc_socket->use_flag = 0;   // &= ~(USE_FLAG_CONNECTED | USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED); // disconnected, socket closed.
1662: 	
1663: 	return 0;
1664: }

1710: int mb_ipc_send(u32 handle, u8 user_cmd, u8 * data_buff, u32 data_len, u32 time_out)
1711: {
1712: 	u32   re_connect = 0;
1713: 
1714: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1715: 
1716: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1717: 	{
1718: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1719: 	}
1720: 
1721: 	// data sanity check.
1722: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1723: 	{
1724: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1725: 	}
1726: 
1727: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED) == 0 )
1728: 	{
1729: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_STATE;
1730: 	}
1731: 
1732: 	if(ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS)
1733: 	{
1734: 		return -MB_IPC_TX_BUSY;
1735: 	}
1736: 
1737: re_send_onetime:
1738: 	
1739: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1740: 
1741: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_SEND_CMD;
1742: 	
1743: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.user_cmd      = user_cmd;
1744: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.cmd_data_len  = data_len;
1745: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.cmd_data_buff = data_buff;
1746: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.cmd_data_crc8 = cal_crc8_0x31(data_buff, data_len);
1747: 
1748: 	u32   retry = 0;
1749: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1750: 
1751: 	do
1752: 	{
1753: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1754: 
1755: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1756: 		
1757: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1758: 		{
1759: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1760: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1761: 		}
1762: 
1763: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1764: 		
1765: 		if(route_status != 0)
1766: 		{
1767: 			// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1768: 			mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1769: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1770: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1771: 			continue;
1772: 		}
1773: 		
1774: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1775: 		{
1776: 			return 0;
1777: 		}
1778: 		else
1779: 		{
1780: 			ret_val = -ipc_socket->tx_status;  // not retry.
1781: 
1782: 			if (ipc_socket->tx_status != (MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE))
1783: 			{
1784: 				break;   // not retry.
1785: 			}
1786: 
1787: 			if(re_connect != 0)
1788: 			{
1789: 				break; // retry failed.
1790: 			}
1791: 			
1792: 			if(IS_CLIENT_PORT(ipc_socket->src_port))
1793: 			{
1794: 				ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~(USE_FLAG_CONNECTED);  // clear CONNECTED flag.
1795: 				if(mb_ipc_connect(handle, ipc_socket->dst_cpu, ipc_socket->dst_port, time_out) == 0)
1796: 				{
1797: 					re_connect = 1;  // retry...
1798: 					break;
1799: 				}
1800: 			}
1801: 			else
1802: 			{
1803: 				break;   // server does not retry.
1804: 			}
1805: 		}
1806: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1807: 
1808: 	if(re_connect == 1)
1809: 	{
1810: 		re_connect = 2; // state to 2, re-send complete.
1811: 
1812: 		// mb_ipc_connect used ipc_socket->tx_cmd, so re-init the tx_cmd.
1813: 		goto re_send_onetime;
1814: 	}
1815: 
1816: 	return ret_val;
1817: }

1927: int mb_ipc_recv_async(u32 handle, u8 * user_cmd, u8 * data_buff, u32 buff_len)
1928: {
1929: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1930: 
1931: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1932: 	{
1933: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1934: 	}
1935: 
1936: 	// data sanity check.
1937: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1938: 	{
1939: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1940: 	}
1941: 
1942: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED) == 0 )
1943: 	{
1944: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_STATE;
1945: 	}
1946: 
1947: 	if(user_cmd != NULL)
1948: 	{
1949: 		*user_cmd = INVALID_USER_CMD_ID;  // initialise.
1950: 	}
1951: 
1952: 	if(ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS)
1953: 	{
1954: 		if(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.hdr.cmd != MB_IPC_SEND_CMD)
1955: 		{
1956: 			if((ipc_socket->rx_cmd.hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG) == 0)
1957: 			{
1958: 				ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_RX_DATA_FAILED);
1959: 			}
1960: 
1961: 			return 0;
1962: 		}
1963: 		
1964: 		if(user_cmd != NULL)
1965: 		{
1966: 			*user_cmd = ipc_socket->rx_cmd.user_cmd;
1967: 		}
1968: 		
1969: 		if( (data_buff == NULL) || (buff_len == 0) )
1970: 		{
1971: 			// discard all data in buffer. after this call, rx_cmd.hdr.cmd is changed.
1972: 			ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
1973: 			return 0;
1974: 		}
1975: 
1976: 		if(ipc_socket->rx_read_offset >= ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_len)
1977: 		{
1978: 			// after this call, rx_cmd.hdr.cmd is changed.
1979: 			ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
1980: 			return 0;
1981: 		}
1982: 
1983: 		u8  * src_buf = (u8 *)(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_buff) + ipc_socket->rx_read_offset;
1984: 		u32   read_len = MIN((ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_len - ipc_socket->rx_read_offset), buff_len);
1985: 
1986: 		#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
1987: 		if(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_len >= (CONFIG_DCACHE_SIZE / 2))
1988: 			flush_all_dcache();
1989: 		else
1990: 			flush_dcache(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_buff, ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_len);
1991: 		#endif
1992: 
1993: 		memcpy(data_buff, src_buf, read_len);
1994: 		ipc_socket->rx_read_offset += read_len;
1995: 
1996: 		// check the buff data validity.
1997: 		u8  crc8 = cal_crc8_0x31(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_buff, ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_len);
1998: 
1999: 		if(crc8 != ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_crc8)  // data buff is damaged in the sender side.
2000: 		{
2001: 			ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_RX_DATA_FAILED);
2002: 			return -MB_IPC_RX_DATA_FAILED;
2003: 		}
2004: 
2005: 		if(ipc_socket->rx_read_offset >= ipc_socket->rx_cmd.cmd_data_len)
2006: 		{
2007: 			ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);  // after this call, rx_cmd.hdr.cmd is changed.
2008: 		}
2009: 		
2010: 		return read_len;
2011: 	}
2012: 
2013: 	return 0;
2014: }

2017: {
2018: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
2019:

2021: 	{

2023: 	}

2046: 		{
2047: 			return 0;

2050: 		{
2051: 			goto recv_data_async;
2052: 		}
2053: 	}
2054: 
2055: 	return 0;
2056: }

111: /* ===============================  internal functions  =========================== */
112: static void shell_mb_rx_isr(shell_mb_ext_t *mb_ext, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
113: {
114: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
115: 
116: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_CMD_LOG_OUT_OK)	/* rsp of log_out_cmd, so free the log_buffer. */
117: 	{
118: 		log_cmd_t * log_cmd = (log_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
119: 
120: 		/* do nothing except notifying app to free buffer. */
121: 		if(mb_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL)
122: 		{
123: 			mb_ext->tx_complete_callback(log_cmd->buf, log_cmd->tag);
124: 		}
125: 
126: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
127: 	}
128: 	else if (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_CMD_LOG_UNBLOCK)
129: 	{
130: 		if (mb_ext->log_blocked == 0) {
131: 			return;
132: 		}
133: 		log_cmd_t * log_cmd = (log_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
134: 		/* do nothing except notifying app to free buffer. */
135: 		if(mb_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL)
136: 		{
137: 			mb_ext->tx_complete_callback(log_cmd->buf, log_cmd->tag);
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
141: 		mb_ext->log_blocked = 0;
142: 		shell_mb_tx_isr2(mb_ext);
143: 
144: 	}
145: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_CMD_USER_INPUT)   /* cmd line inputs. */
146: 	{
147: 		user_cmd_t * user_cmd = (user_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
148: 
149: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
150: 		flush_dcache((void *)user_cmd->buf, user_cmd->len);
151: #endif
152: 
153: 		if((user_cmd->len >= RX_BUFF_SIZE) || (mb_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx != mb_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx))
154: 		{
155: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
156: 		}
157: 		else
158: 		{
159: 			memcpy(mb_ext->rx_buff, user_cmd->buf, user_cmd->len);
160: 
161: 			result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;    /* it means the buffer can be freed. cmd is pending and will rsp later by MB_CMD_LOG_OUT. */
162: 
163: 			mb_ext->rx_data_len = user_cmd->len;
164: 			mb_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx++;	/* prevent mb_rx_isr from receiving new cmd. */
165: 		}
166: 
167: 		if(mb_ext->rx_indicate_callback != NULL)
168: 		{
169: 			mb_ext->rx_indicate_callback();
170: 		}
171: 	}
172: 	else   /* unknown cmd. */
173: 	{
174: 		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf->param3 after the ISR handle complete.
178: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
179: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / outpu as result ]  !!!!
180: 	 */
181: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
182: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
183: 
184: 	return;
185: }

187: static void shell_mb_tx_isr2(shell_mb_ext_t *mb_ext)
188: {
189: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t	mb_cmd_buf;
190: 	if (mb_ext->log_blocked) {
191: 		return;
192: 	}
193: 	/* next tx. */
194: 	if(mb_ext->list_out_idx != mb_ext->list_in_idx)
195: 	{
196: 		mb_ext->cur_packet = mb_ext->tx_list[mb_ext->list_out_idx].packet;
197: 		mb_ext->packet_len = mb_ext->tx_list[mb_ext->list_out_idx].len;
198: 		mb_ext->packet_tag = mb_ext->tx_list[mb_ext->list_out_idx].tag;
199: 
200: 		log_cmd_t * cmd_buf = (log_cmd_t *)&mb_cmd_buf;
201: 
202: 		cmd_buf->hdr.data = 0;
203: 		cmd_buf->hdr.cmd = MB_CMD_LOG_OUT;
204: 		cmd_buf->buf = mb_ext->cur_packet;
205: 		cmd_buf->len = mb_ext->packet_len;
206: 		cmd_buf->tag = mb_ext->packet_tag;
207: 
208: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
209: 
210: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_write(mb_ext->chnl_id, &mb_cmd_buf);
211: 
212: 		if(ret_code == BK_OK)
213: 		{
214: 			/* to next packet. */
215: 			mb_ext->list_out_idx = (mb_ext->list_out_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
216: 		} else {
217: 			mb_ext->tx_stopped = 1;
218: 		}
219: 	}
220: 	else
221: 	{
222: 		/* all packets tx complete. */
223: 
224: 		mb_ext->cur_packet = NULL;
225: 		mb_ext->packet_len = 0;
226: 
227: 		mb_ext->tx_stopped = 1; /* bTRUE;*/  /* all data tranferred, tx stopped.*/
228: 	}
229: }

232: {

234: 	{
235: 		/*
236: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
237: 		 */
238: 
239: 	//	return;
240: 	}
241: 	
242: 	if ( ((ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) == 0) && 
243:      		(ack_buf->ack_state & ACK_STATE_BLOCK) ) {
244: 		mb_ext->log_blocked = 1;

257: 		}

269: static bk_err_t write_sync(shell_mb_ext_t *mb_ext, u8 * p_buf, u16 buf_len)
270: {
271: 	volatile u8 * buff_busy;
272: 	u8 *   tx_buff;
273: 
274: 	if(arch_is_enter_exception())
275: 	{
276: 		emergency_uart_write_buf(CONFIG_DUMP_UART_PRINT_PORT, (const char *)p_buf, buf_len);
277: 		return BK_OK;
278: 	}
279: 
280: 	if(mb_ext->tx_sync_buf == NULL)
281: 	{
282: 		mb_ext->tx_sync_buf = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(mb_ext->chnl_id);
283: 		mb_ext->tx_sync_len = mb_chnl_get_buff_len();
284: 
285: 		if(mb_ext->tx_sync_buf == NULL)
286: 			return BK_FAIL;
287: 	}
288: 
289: 	tx_buff = mb_ext->tx_sync_buf;
290: 
291: 	u16				cpy_len;
292: 	bk_err_t		ret_code = BK_OK;
293: 	
294: 	while(buf_len > 0)
295: 	{
296: 		cpy_len = buf_len;
297: 		
298: 		if((buf_len + 1) > mb_ext->tx_sync_len)
299: 		{
300: 			cpy_len = mb_ext->tx_sync_len - 1;
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		buff_busy = (volatile u8 * )&tx_buff[0];
304: 		tx_buff[0] = 1;  /* the buffer is busy. */
305: 		memcpy(&tx_buff[1], p_buf, cpy_len);
306: 
307: 		mb_chnl_cmd_t	mb_cmd_buf;
308: 		log_cmd_t * cmd_buf = (log_cmd_t *)&mb_cmd_buf;
309: 
310: 		cmd_buf->hdr.data = 0;
311: 		cmd_buf->hdr.cmd = MB_CMD_ASSERT_OUT;
312: 		cmd_buf->buf = tx_buff;
313: 		cmd_buf->len = cpy_len + 1;
314: 		cmd_buf->tag = 0xFFFF;		/* tx_buff is not dynamically allocated memory. */
315: 
316: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_ctrl(mb_ext->chnl_id, MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC, &mb_cmd_buf);
317: 
318: 		if(ret_code == BK_OK)
319: 		{
320: 			while(*buff_busy)
321: 			{
322: 				/* wait buffer to be free (*buff_busy == 0). */
323: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
324: 				flush_dcache((void *)buff_busy, 1);
325: 				#endif
326: 			}
327: 		}
328: 		else
329: 		{
330: 			break;
331: 		}
332: 
333: 		buf_len -= cpy_len;
334: 		p_buf += cpy_len;
335: 
336: 	};
337: 
338: 	return ret_code;
339: }
